## Intent — what this is for

§3.1(5) idle-release + WORK-R8-style lease record + transparent reconnect; §5.1 durable sessions (deterministic pclaw-<project>-<run>-<session> names, reattach-not-reap boot pre-step in both orphan recoveries, agents.durable_sessions flag); §11 Session 5

## Done when

SC5: killing the gateway mid-run with durable sessions on → the recovery sweep reattaches to the still-alive tmux worker (run resumes suspended→running, journal flags `resumed`), only genuinely dead sessions are tombstoned; a claimed runner idle past TTL is released and its lease holder is visible in Settings
